description: Read how many conversations the agent replied in over a date range (ai_threads), and how many are currently handed from the agent to the business and still awaiting a business reply (ai_handoffs). Counts are per conversation, not per message, and match the business's own agent summaries. Returns {data: [one row]}, each metric as {count}, present only when requested. Known limitation: ai_handoffs is a SNAPSHOT of the present moment - it ignores start_date and end_date. The range may span at most 90 days, counting both ends, and each requested metric costs a separate scan, so ask only for what you need.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

metrics.description: Which metrics to return. Omit for all of them.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

name: mba_get_conversation_insights
title: Read conversation insights
